candidate.name: C30 five-ETF balanced strategic basket
candidate.selection_basis: Economic exposure budget fixed before calculations; not selected from historical score.
candidate.rebalance_style: Restore the fixed target vector at each scheduled event; do not use a market-data signal or discretionary override.

economic_rationale: Use a limited domestic equity sleeve, a five-year government-bond sleeve, a small domestic-gold sleeve, and a money-market ETF sleeve for exposure diversification and operational liquidity; no correlation, protection, liquidity, or 5 percent outcome is asserted.

source.basis: Unadjusted-or-undisclosed SSE market-price proxy only; not total return, NAV return, execution, or point-in-time data.

timing.decision_sessions: Final common close in June and December; initialization decision is the first common close.
timing.effective_sessions: Strictly the following common session at reported open.
timing.overnight_sequence: Existing holdings receive decision-close to effective-open proxy move before trade; post-trade targets receive effective-open to effective-close proxy move.

illustrative_cost.formula: one_way_turnover * bps / 10000 deducted from pre-trade proxy NAV, including initial one-way entry

research_hurdle.meaning: Long-run research objective only; not a guarantee, annual floor, prediction, or suitability conclusion.
research_hurdle.limited_proxy_screen: Reject if any complete calendar-year or monthly-end rolling-five-year price proxy falls below 5 percent; passing could not admit the strategy.

required_outputs: maximum drawdown and daily/20-session price-proxy loss observations
no_action_conditions: Missing current product, legal-document, temporary-announcement, market-status, account, fee, tax, settlement, quote, depth, IOPV where applicable, or reconciliation evidence.
Halt, delisting, price limit, material product change, account or settlement failure, unavailable funds/shares, or either equity leg not checked.
Lot/tick failure, partial fill, rejection, no fill, or inability to reconcile a prior paper ledger.

forward_paper_order_protection.failure: no_action; preserve prior paper holdings; no substitution or assumed fill

veto_basis: No point-in-time total-return or corporate-action ledger.
No dated bid/ask, depth, halt, price-limit, cost, tax, fill, settlement, or capacity ledger.
No portfolio value, loss budget, user risk limits, or forward-paper verification record.
